places.name: Old Town Rovinj
places.ai_summary: Old Town Rovinj is a picturesque medieval town with narrow cobblestone streets, colorful houses, and a vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Visit early in the morning to avoid crowds and enjoy the serene atmosphere.

places.name: St. Euphemia’s Church
places.ai_summary: St. Euphemia’s Church is a Baroque-style church offering panoramic views of Rovinj and the Adriatic Sea from its bell tower.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during religious services.

places.place_tip: Climb the bell tower for the best views of Rovinj.

places.name: Rovinj Harbor
places.ai_summary: Rovinj Harbor is a charming and bustling port area, perfect for a leisurely stroll, dining, and enjoying the seaside atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed in the evening for the sunset views.

places.place_tip: Try the local seafood at one of the harbor-side restaurants.

places.name: Balbi’s Arch
places.ai_summary: Balbi’s Arch is a historical archway that once served as the main entrance to the town, offering a glimpse into Rovinj’s past.

opening_hours.notes: Best viewed during the day.

places.place_tip: Take a moment to appreciate the details of the arch and the views of the harbor.

places.name: Grisia Street Art Alley
places.ai_summary: Grisia Street Art Alley is a vibrant and colorful street showcasing impressive street art and murals by various artists.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored on foot.

places.place_tip: Bring your camera to capture the amazing artwork.

places.name: Golden Cape Forest Park (Zlatni Rt)
places.ai_summary: Golden Cape Forest Park is a tranquil retreat with walking trails, secluded beaches, and lush greenery, perfect for nature lovers.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Bring a picnic and enjoy the serene surroundings.

places.name: Rovinj Town Museum
places.ai_summary: Rovinj Town Museum is located in a historic palace and offers insights into the rich history and culture of Rovinj.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique souvenirs.

places.name: Main Square (Trg Maršala Tita)
places.ai_summary: The Main Square is the central square of Rovinj, surrounded by historic buildings, cafes, and shops, and often hosting local events.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a coffee at one of the cafes and people-watch.

places.name: Batana Eco-Museum
places.ai_summary: The Batana Eco-Museum is dedicated to the traditional wooden boat called Batana, showcasing Rovinj’s maritime heritage.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a boat tour to see the Batana in action.

places.name: Lone Bay Beach
places.ai_summary: Lone Bay Beach is a beautiful and peaceful beach, ideal for swimming, sunbathing, and enjoying the natural surroundings.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring your own snacks and drinks, as there are limited facilities.

attribution.title: Second World War: Europe; "Into the Jaws of Death — U.S. Troops wading through water and Nazi gunfire”, circa 1944-06-06.
attribution.author: Chief Photographer's Mate (CPHoM) Robert F. Sargent
attribution.description: A LCVP (Landing Craft, Vehicle, Personnel) from the U.S. Coast Guard-manned USS Samuel Chase disembarks troops of Company A, 16th Infantry, 1st Infantry Division (the Big Red One) wading onto the Fox Green section of Omaha Beach (Calvados, Basse-Normandie, France) on the morning of June 6, 1944. American soldiers encountered the newly formed German 352nd Division when landing. During the initial landing two-thirds of Company E became casualties.

places.name: Punta Corrente Park
places.ai_summary: Punta Corrente Park is a scenic park with walking and cycling paths, beaches, and picnic areas, located near the Golden Cape.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored by bike or on foot.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the scenic views from the cliffs.

places.name: Rovinj Aquarium
places.ai_summary: Rovinj Aquarium is a small but interesting aquarium showcasing the marine life of the Adriatic Sea.

opening_hours.notes: Check for feeding times for an enhanced experience.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a walk in the nearby park.

places.name: Monte Mulini Beach
places.ai_summary: Monte Mulini Beach is a beautiful pebbly beach known for its clear waters and natural shade, ideal for a relaxing day by the sea.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring your own beach umbrella for shade.

places.name: Rovinj Marina
places.ai_summary: Rovinj Marina is a well-equipped marina offering various services for boaters and a pleasant promenade for walkers.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or evening.

places.place_tip: Check out the local boat tours available.

places.name: Franciscan Monastery
places.ai_summary: The Franciscan Monastery is a peaceful retreat with a beautiful church and a museum, set in a tranquil garden.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events or services.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum for insights into the local history.

places.name: Carera Street Market
places.ai_summary: Carera Street Market is a lively market offering a variety of local products, souvenirs, and fresh produce.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning.

places.place_tip: Don’t forget to bargain for the best prices.

places.name: Brijuni Islands National Park (Boat Trip)
places.ai_summary: The Brijuni Islands National Park is a stunning archipelago with rich biodiversity, accessible by a short boat trip from Rovinj.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended for the boat trip.

places.place_tip: Bring your camera for the stunning landscapes and wildlife.

places.name: Panorama Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: The Panorama Viewpoint offers a breathtaking view of Rovinj, the surrounding islands, and the Adriatic Sea, especially beautiful at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunset.

places.place_tip: Bring a bottle of water and enjoy the view.

places.ai_summary: The Old Fisherman’s Wharf is a historic part of Rovinj’s waterfront, with charming old buildings and fishing boats.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Enjoy the fresh seafood from the local vendors.

places.name: Red Island Excursion
places.ai_summary: The Red Island Excursion is a popular boat trip from Rovinj to the nearby Red Island, known for its beautiful beaches and clear waters.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended for the boat trip.

places.place_tip: Bring your snorkeling gear to explore the underwater life.

attribution.title: US Navy 010703-N-5329L-005 Diver working on USS Monitor salvage
attribution.author: U.S. Navy Photo by Photographer’s Mate 2nd Class Petty Officer Eric Lippmann.
attribution.description:
010703-N-5329L-005
Atlantic Ocean (July 3, 2001) – U.S. Navy diver, Senior Chief Engineman Bill Staples from Somersworth, N.H., uses a hammer and chisel to free deck plating from the historic wreck of USS Monitor.  Staples and other U.S. Navy saturation divers are working around the clock with archaeologists from the National Oceanographic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) to salvage the main engine and other artifacts from the wreck to be preserved and later displayed at The Mariners Museum in Newport News, VA.  Divers are working from the Derrick Barge “Wotan”, which is acting as the main support vessel during the Monitor 2001 Expedition, the sixth joint U.S. Navy and NOAA expedition to preserve the historic vessel.  The ship went down off the coast of Cape Hatteras, NC, in 1862 during a severe storm.  U.S. Navy Photo by Photographer’s Mate 2nd Class Petty Officer Eric Lippmann.  (RELEASED)
